tool.name: OGS: MapGeometryToMeshSurface
tool.description: Maps geometric objects to the surface of a given mesh.

param.label: mesh file
param.help: Input (.vtu). The name of the input file containing the mesh

param.label: input geometry
param.help: Input (.gml). The name of the file containing the input geometry

param.label: additional insert mapping
param.help: Advanced mapping algorithm will be applied, i.e. a new geometry will be created and possibly new points will be inserted.

tool.help: Maps geometric objects to the surface of a given mesh. The documentation is available at https://docs.opengeosys.org/docs/tools/model-preparation/map-geometric-object-to-the-surface-of-a-mesh.
